findings.finding: H1 operating profit is on course to land roughly 3-5% under the company's H1 plan (8,322m OP / 8,451m ordinary): Q1 delivered 4,151m OP (49.9% of the H1 plan) with sales 'slightly below plan', and Q2 has run at 83-95% of Q1 ordinary in the last two years (FY26 3,713 vs 3,916; FY25 3,495 vs 4,220), implying H1 ordinary ~7,800-8,300m -- centred on the 8,095m consensus, so a miss vs plan but not vs the street; the System Kiko tank-cleaning work deferred from Q1 into Q2 is the upside swing.

Q1 FY27 (2026-07-02), a record quarter that slightly missed the 4,360 consensus: -4.71%. Closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9793.T?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the consensus H1 ordinary (8,095) already sits 4.2% under the company plan, the stock is -13% since the Q1 print and Nomura trimmed its target 5,300->5,100 on 2026-08-17. What is not priced is only where inside the 7,800-8,300 range Q2 lands, which is a coin flip around consensus -- hence near zero.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 16,800m, +15.1%) needs H2 ordinary of ~8,900m (+23% YoY) if H1 lands near consensus; the company missed its initial FY26 plan (OP 15,700 -> 14,588 actual), held the FY plan at the FY26 H1 print despite an H1 miss, and revised in January in both FY25 and FY26, so a cut at this print is a low-probability tail while a hold is consensus-neutral (consensus FY 17,121 is above plan).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY plan held at H1 FY26 (2025-10-02): -3.56%. FY25 Q3 (2025-01-06) FY + dividend revision: +7.69%. FY26 Q3 (2026-01-07) dividend revision: -3.18%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus FY ordinary 17,121 is still ABOVE the company's 17,000, so the street has not marked down H2; a cut now would be news. But the company's own record is to hold at H1 and move in January, which is why the expected size is small.
